QF.id: III-C Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices_3

question.text: Under Chapter II of the SEBI PFUTP Regulations, which of the following is prohibited in relation to securities?

answer.text: Employing any manipulative or deceptive device in connection with purchase or sale
Selling securities in a fraudulent manner
All three: employing manipulative or deceptive devices in connection with purchase or sale; selling securities in a fraudulent manner; and buying securities in a fraudulent manner
Buying securities in a fraudulent manner

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.2.1 of the workbook, Chapter II of the SEBI PFUTP Regulations prohibits a person from directly or indirectly buying, selling or dealing in securities in a fraudulent manner, employing any manipulative or deceptive device, or engaging in any act or scheme to defraud. All three activities are independently prohibited. The Trap: Each single-activity distractor is correct on its own. Candidates may think only the selling side, or only manipulative devices, are caught — but PFUTP catches buying, selling and the use of manipulative or deceptive devices, in respect of securities that are listed or proposed to be listed. Note: Replaced the answer-randomization-fragile 'All of the above' wording with a standalone comprehensive option that lists the three prohibited activities, and removed the pro-tip line that was not source-grounded.
